#!/bin/bash
# DIAWW.DEV - Pterodactyl Node.js Installation Script

apt update -y
apt install -y git curl ca-certificates

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "true" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "1" ]; then
    echo -e "\033[1;33m[DIAWW.DEV]\033[0m USER_UPLOAD enabled. Skipping git clone."
    exit 0
fi

if [ -z "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
    echo -e "\033[1;33m[DIAWW.DEV]\033[0m No GIT_ADDRESS specified. Creating default index.js..."
    if [ ! -f index.js ]; then
        cat << 'EOF' > index.js
console.log("[DIAWW.DEV] Node.js container is up and running!");
setInterval(() => {
    console.log("[DIAWW.DEV] Server heartbeat tick: " + new Date().toISOString());
}, 30000);
EOF
    fi
    exit 0
fi

GIT_TARGET="${GIT_ADDRESS}"
if [ ! -z "${GIT_USERNAME}" ] && [ ! -z "${GIT_ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
    GIT_TARGET="https://${GIT_USERNAME}:${GIT_ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo -e ${GIT_ADDRESS} | cut -d/ -f3-)"
fi

echo -e "\033[1;36m[DIAWW.DEV]\033[0m Cloning repository from ${GIT_ADDRESS}..."
if [ -z "${BRANCH}" ]; then
    git clone ${GIT_TARGET} .
else
    git clone --single-branch --branch ${BRANCH} ${GIT_TARGET} .
fi

PKG_TARGET="${PACKAGE_FILE}"
if [ -z "${PKG_TARGET}" ]; then PKG_TARGET="package.json"; fi
if [ -f "${PKG_TARGET}" ]; then
    echo -e "\033[1;36m[DIAWW.DEV]\033[0m Installing dependencies from ${PKG_TARGET}..."
    npm install
fi

echo -e "\033[1;32m[DIAWW.DEV]\033[0m Installation complete!"
